x: The two Hurdle races gave us two very welcome third places with Angus Scott very unlucky in not reaching the final. The field events were, as expected, the weakest part of our team’s performances, although Paterson’s high-jumping was magnificent and Savidge in the shot, Geoff Elliott in the decathlo…
Other names to go on to better things were John Wilkinson and J.M.K Finley in the sprints, Angus Scott in the 880 and Chris Brasher in the 3 miles.

Angus Scott and Douglas Gracie pushed Whittle hard in all the Championships. The steeplechase in Britain had shown dramatic improvement after the National Coach Geoff Dyson persuaded John Disley to turn to the event from miling, resulting in new British Records.
